thread:
elaine.ae: Heads-up — Primera RFI landed. They attached the questionnaire and want clarity on dataset access for the POC, egress/billing, and KPI measurements. I uploaded the PDF here: https://drive.company/primera_rfi_q1.pdf. Who can own technical answers?

ops-bot: Uploaded file `primera_rfi_q1.pdf` (2.1MB) to #sales thread.

tom.se: I can own the infra/connectors section. Quick clarifying Q — do they expect Private (VPC) for the POC or will hosted suffice initially? The RFI mentions both.

elaine.ae: They prefer Private long-term but said "hosted for quick eval if we can guarantee no data leakage". Also asked about KMS/HSM support and whether we can ingest via their S3 buckets.

maria.security: Basic security checklist notes: we need to confirm 1) KMS integration (customer-managed keys) 2) access audit logging for ingestion 3) retention + deletion policy for the POC artifacts 4) whether sample data contains PII (NDA needed). We can allow presigned S3 ingestion, but must document the threat model and token rotation.

raj.product: For product answers — propose we offer two POC modes in the RFI: 1) Hosted eval: quick onboarding, limited quotas, ephemeral logs 2) Private VPC: full audit, KMS keys, network peering. Suggested POC quotas: 100k generated tokens, 10k embedding units, and up to 500GB ingress (we can absorb first 500GB for POC). We'll provide KPI definitions: latency (p50/p95), throughput (reqs/min), and semantic quality (QA eval set accuracy).

chris.finance: Pricing input: recommend a POC credit of $8,000 covering hosted usage and support. If they choose Private and need reserved capacity, minimum commit $20k/month. Egress policy: propose we cover first 500GB for the POC, additional egress billed at our standard egress rate (~$0.09/GB) — call this out explicitly in the RFI. Also note we can provide an estimate table if they share expected tokens/month.

elaine.ae: Good. Can someone draft the short RFI answers for dataset access and billing so I can paste into their template? They want a sentence for each: "ingestion method", "data residency", "KMS/HSM", "retention", "egress billing" and an attachments list.

tom.se: Draft below — use as-is or edit.

---

Tom (draft):
- Ingestion method: Customer uploads dataset to their S3. For the POC we support read-only presigned URLs or cross-account IAM role. We recommend presigned URLs with TTL 24h for one-time ingestion.
- Data residency: For hosted eval, data is stored in the region selected for the tenant (AWS us-west-2 by default). For Private deployments we support customer-managed VPCs and on-prem installs to meet residency requirements.
- KMS/HSM: We support customer-managed KMS for encryption-at-rest. For Private/on-prem options we can integrate with customer HSMs; require additional SOW.
- Retention: POC artifacts (logs, ephemeral caches) retained for up to 14 days by default; long‑term retention can be configured per-contract.
- Egress billing: For the POC we will absorb the first 500GB of egress. Additional egress billed at $0.09/GB. For Private deployments, network egress is governed by customer cloud/provider bills and pass-throughs.

Example presign command we recommend (for docs):

```bash
aws s3 presign s3://primera-shared-bucket/sample.tar.gz --expires-in 86400
```

---

maria.security: Slight edits: call out that presigned URLs must be scoped read-only and rotated for multi-batch ingestions. Also change retention to "14 days by default for hosted POC; shorter on request for sensitive data". Add: "We require a signed DPA/NDA before ingesting any PII samples."

raj.product: Add KPI bullets to the same answer bundle:
- Latency SLO: p50 < 150ms, p95 < 350ms for up to 8k token sequence in Dedicated config.
- Throughput: baseline 50 reqs/min for hosted POC; Dedicated reserved configs available for higher throughput.
- Quality: we'll run a small eval suite (provided by customer) and report rouge/embedding-similarity scores weekly.

chris.finance: Also include an attachments list: pricing sheet (attached), standard DPA, POC SOW template, and the sample runbook. I'll upload the pricing sheet now.

ops-bot: Uploaded file `primera_poc_pricing_v1.xlsx` (24KB).

elaine.ae: Perfect. Quick checklist before I send final RFI: 1) Confirm presign + cross-account supported (tom) 2) Confirm KMS wording (maria) 3) Final pricing bullet (chris) 4) One-paragraph POC summary for execs (raj). Can we close this in next 2 hours?

tom.se: Confirmed presign and cross-account role supported. For cross-account we need the customer's read-only role ARN; we'll provide the Terraform snippet if they want automation.

maria.security: Confirm KMS wording accepted. We'll attach the minimal security addendum phrasing.

chris.finance: Pricing bullet final: POC credit $8k (one-time), covers support + first 500GB egress. Overages at standard rates. Private deployment pricing starts at $20k/mo commit.

raj.product: Exec one-paragraph (pasteable): "Redwood Inference will run a focused POC with Primera to validate model integration and performance at production-representative scale. The POC can start on hosted infrastructure for speed or a Private VPC for data-sensitive workloads. During the 2-4 week engagement we will measure latency and throughput against agreed KPIs and deliver a findings report with recommended serving configuration and cost estimates."

eleine.ae: Awesome — I'll assemble and send. Thanks all :thumbsup:

maria.security: One last note — add contact for security questionnaire clarifications: maria.security@redwood.ai

elaine.ae: Will do. Sending now.
